$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit converter family — Converter Profile. Major version 1. Stage input contract for capability probes and the resolver. Local project-source paths are supplied per run (CLI > env > this local profile file, in that precedence); a committed example uses placeholder paths and NEVER an owner's real path. Placeholder paths matching the sentinel pattern are treated as PROJECT_SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED. The V1 profile family stays frozen at its own major; the two families are independent.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Converter Profile

platformId.description: Adapter-declared platform id. A probe applied to an unsupported platformId fails with ADAPTER_NOT_APPLICABLE.

platformVersionConstraint.description: Optional observed-version expectation (informational; the registry records what was actually observed).

sourceId.description: Referenced by evidence locators as source://<sourceId>/... .

kind.description: Adapter-defined source kind (e.g. a platform checkout, or a fixture pack for synthetic profiles).

path.description: Optional local checkout path. Committed examples use placeholders like /path/to/<project> (sentinel: any path containing '/path/to/' is treated as not configured). Never commit a real owner path; local overrides live in gitignored *.local.* files.

projectSources.description: May be empty: generic core tasks run with no project source at all.

scopes.description: Visibility bounds for read-only probes. Requests outside scopes fail closed (LOCATOR_OUT_OF_SCOPE at the source-port layer).

responsiveDeterministicRequired.description: Escalates RESPONSIVE_UNCERTAIN from advisory to blocking when true. Gates may tighten, never loosen.

gates.description: Gate overlay: tighten-only. Profiles may escalate advisories to blocking; nothing may demote an error.

approvedWriteTargets.$comment: Converter major 1 covers read-only capability probes and resolution only. Any approved write target requires a new schema major plus a stage GO ADR — fail closed by construction.
